clues: A town in Oklahoma, in the south of the United States. It lies a short drive south of the state capital.
This place sits in Tornado Alley. Storms here spin up tornados that come often and hit hard.
Crowds rushed in to settle here in the Land Run of 1889. The town was made a city two years later, in 1891.
A state school here holds a vast art trove. It is the largest gift of French Impressionist art to an American school.
This is home to the University of Oklahoma. Its sports teams are the Sooners, and huge crowds pack their football games.
